candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot comparison, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK December 2025 and January 2026 values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag. They do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.derived_snapshot: Deltas, ratios, shares and ranks are deterministic calculations over displayed rounded totals and comparable contract rows. They are not official statistics, supplier performance verdicts, forecasts or parcel-level delivery claims.
scope_guards.missing_value: A displayed dash is preserved as missing rather than converted to zero. Calculations requiring the missing January value are not performed.
scope_guards.contract_scope: Ofcom business-contract guidance is a process summary. Rights and obligations depend on customer size, contract wording, service and case facts and are not legal advice.
scope_guards.sla_scope: Service-level terms and compensation depend on the specific agreement and do not establish network availability or performance at a particular address.
scope_guards.consumer_contract_scope: Ofcom's checklist describes general residential and small-business protections. Applicability depends on the contract, customer category and facts.
scope_guards.speed_scope: Speed information and remedies depend on the service, provider and contract and do not guarantee measured performance at a particular premises.
scope_guards.complaint_scope: Complaint and ADR guidance describes escalation routes and eligibility, not the merits or outcome of an individual case.

expansion_rule: Join Wave151 December values to Wave155 January values by normalized contract name. For each of 37 contracts emit sixteen records: contracted delta, built delta or missing guard, built percentage change or missing/zero-base guard, December built ratio, January built ratio or missing guard, ratio-point change or missing guard, December and January shares of displayed contracted totals, December and January shares of displayed built totals or missing guard, December and January contracted ranks, December and January built ranks or missing guard, change in unbuilt gap, and a combined continuity classification. Append 68 Ofcom contract and checklist records. Equal numeric values share competition rank. Every fifth expanded record is REVALIDATION; all others are UPGRADE.
